title: Easy
body: I always try to meditate and exercise every day, but I'm too lazy to do that. When I got this app, I did it everyday! If you are looking for a new app that will help you get into new and good habits try something daily or try to set a goal and get it done.

title: Great
body: simple and lovely! Myday section is very interesting, please allow us to insert some pictures into the activity note! it's also better if it has a time tracker and more options for customizing habits.

title: Great app
body: This is the most comprehensive application without fluff that I have found. There are a few quirks, but nothing distracting. The advantage is that this tracker with a clean interface allows you to set a routine for daily, a certain day or many days of the week, month or year.
author: Miep Hostetler
